title: Venus Legacy vs 5D Lipozero: Which to Choose
h1: Venus Legacy vs 5D Lipozero: which one for cellulite, loose skin and stubborn fat?
desc: Venus Legacy vs 5D Lipozero compared: technology, cellulite, skin tightening, fat reduction, face use, sessions and prices at Skin & Laser Dubai.
answer: Both use radiofrequency to tighten skin and reshape the body with no downtime. Venus Legacy adds PEMF and pulsed suction, so it is especially good for cellulite, skin quality and the face. 5D Lipozero adds ultrasound cavitation, so it leans more towards fat reduction in specific areas, from AED 600 + VAT per area. Many plans combine them.
body:
## Technology

Venus Legacy: radiofrequency, PEMF and VariPulse suction. 5D Lipozero: radiofrequency, ultrasound cavitation and vacuum. Both heat the tissue to tighten collagen; cavitation targets fat more directly, while PEMF and pulsed suction support skin renewal and drainage.

## Which to choose

- Dimpled thighs or buttocks: Venus Legacy
- A soft tummy or love handles: 5D Lipozero
- Loose skin on arms or abdomen: either, often combined
- Jawline and fine lines: Venus Legacy face

## Sessions

Venus Legacy usually needs 4 to 8 body sessions or 3 to 6 face sessions. 5D Lipozero often needs 1 to 2 sessions per area. Results build over several weeks for both.
